source_summary: Chinese landscape painting with ink-and-color mountains, misty lake, rocky cliffs, clustered buildings, trees, and distant hills; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: misty_blue_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Pale blue-gray distant mountain silhouettes rising behind the left ridgeline, including the tall vertical peak and smaller adjoining peak softened by mist.
must_preserve: vertical peak shape and smaller rear peak

motifs.name: left_towering_rock_cliff
motifs.description: Large left-side mountain mass with steep cliff faces, layered ridges, dark vegetation strokes, and blue-gray wash accents, excluding the foreground buildings below.
must_preserve: dark clustered shrub strokes along ridges

motifs.name: mid_right_rolling_hills
motifs.description: Low rolling hills and distant shoreline across the lake on the middle right, with a central rounded peak and faint blue mountains behind.

motifs.name: overhanging_cliff_pine
motifs.description: Prominent pine growing from the cliff near the center-left, its trunk emerging from rock and its horizontal canopy extending outward over the drop.

motifs.name: lakeside_hamlet_red_tree
motifs.description: Small settlement on a rocky lakeside shelf beneath the cliff, including clustered low roofs, dark fence-like strokes, slender trees, and a red-orange autumn tree.

motifs.name: lower_left_stilt_pavilion
motifs.description: Foreground-left waterside pavilion group with stacked roofs and stilt supports, set against the pale water edge and nearby small bare tree.

motifs.name: central_foreground_tree_grove
motifs.description: Tall foreground grove near the lower center with multiple trunks, willow-like drooping foliage, dark vertical trees, and orange-brown leaf accents on a rocky bank.
must_preserve: rocky base with pale green wash

motifs.name: right_autumn_shore_tree
motifs.description: Right foreground shore motif with a leaning dark tree, orange-red foliage, shrubs, rocks, and pale water behind it.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
